lines.text: Moses says to appoint judges and officials in every town, who must not accept a bribe, since it blinds the eyes of the wise.
Moses forbids setting up a wooden Asherah pole or a sacred pillar, and forbids sacrificing a flawed ox or sheep.
If a report of idolatry proves true, the guilty person is stoned at the gates on the word of twelve witnesses.
Hard cases go to the Levitical priests and the judge at the place the LORD will choose, and their verdict must be obeyed.
The king must be chosen by the elders of Israel, must not gather many horses, and must read his scroll all his life.

wrong_details.wrong: chosen by the elders of Israel
